name: Brickfield Gardens Playground
description: Playground on Southwater Close and Copenhagen Place with toddler play (under 5s) and junior play (5 and over). Over half the equipment suits children with additional needs, and the council planned to replace the playground in 2024, as Tower Hamlets Council lists it.
